internal class AndroidArchiveDocumentPort(
    private val readDocument: suspend (Uri) -> ByteArray?,
    private val writeDocument: suspend (Uri, ByteArray) -> Unit,
    private val readImportedFile: suspend (String) -> ByteArray? = { null },
    private val isImportedFile: (String) -> Boolean = { false },
    private val clearImports: suspend () -> Unit = {},
    private val ioDispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.IO,
) : ArchiveDocumentPort {
    constructor(context: Context) : this(
        readDocument = { uri ->
            context.applicationContext.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { it.readArchiveBytes() }
        },
        writeDocument = { uri, bytes ->
            val output = context.applicationContext.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")
                ?: throw IOException("The document provider did not return an output stream")
            output.use { stream ->
                var offset = 0
                while (offset < bytes.size) {
                    currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
                    val length = minOf(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE, bytes.size - offset)
                    stream.write(bytes, offset, length)
                    offset += length
                }
            }
        },
        readImportedFile = { path ->
            File(path).takeIf { it.isFile }?.inputStream()?.use { it.readArchiveBytes() }
        },
        isImportedFile = { path -> isCanonicalImportedFile(context.applicationContext, path) },
        clearImports = { clearAndroidImportedArchives(File(context.applicationContext.filesDir, "imports")) },
    )

    override suspend fun read(documentId: String): ByteArray? = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
        val uri = Uri.parse(documentId)
        val bytes = when {
            uri.scheme == "content" -> readDocument(uri)
            uri.scheme == null -> {
                require(isImportedFile(documentId)) { "Android archive file must be app-owned" }
                readImportedFile(documentId)
            }
            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Android archive documents must use content URIs or app-owned paths")
        }
        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
        bytes
    }

    override suspend fun write(documentId: String, bytes: ByteArray) = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
        writeDocument(documentId.contentUri(), bytes)
        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
    }

    override suspend fun clearImportedArchives() = withContext(ioDispatcher) {
        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
        clearImports()
    }

    private fun String.contentUri(): Uri = Uri.parse(this).also { uri ->
        require(uri.scheme == "content") { "Android archive documents must use content URIs" }
    }
}

private suspend fun InputStream.readArchiveBytes(): ByteArray {
    val result = ByteArrayOutputStream()
    val buffer = ByteArray(DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE)
    while (true) {
        currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive()
        val count = read(buffer)
        if (count < 0) break
        result.write(buffer, 0, count)
    }
    return result.toByteArray()
}

internal fun clearAndroidImportedArchives(imports: File) {
    // A symlink must never turn the app-owned cleanup root into an external document directory.
    val canonicalRoot = imports.canonicalFile
    require(canonicalRoot.parentFile == imports.parentFile.canonicalFile) {
        "Archive import directory must be app-owned"
    }
    if (!canonicalRoot.exists()) return
    val files = checkNotNull(canonicalRoot.listFiles()) { "Unable to inspect imported archives" }
    files.forEach { file ->
        require(file.canonicalFile.parentFile == canonicalRoot && file.isFile) {
            "Imported archive must remain app-owned"
        }
        check(file.delete()) { "Unable to clear imported archive" }
    }
}

private fun isCanonicalImportedFile(context: Context, path: String): Boolean = runCatching {
    val importsRoot = File(context.filesDir, "imports").canonicalFile
    val candidate = File(path).canonicalFile
    candidate.isFile && candidate.parentFile == importsRoot
}.getOrDefault(false)

/** Application-scoped production graph. Hosts construct and retain exactly one instance. */
class ProductionAppGraph internal constructor(
    driverFactory: SqlDriverFactory,
    settings: Settings,
    private val privateFileStore: PrivateFileStore,
    private val pendingPhotoImportStore: PendingPhotoImportStore,
    documentPort: ArchiveDocumentPort,
    reminderDriver: ReminderDriver,
    private val notificationPermissionService: NotificationPermissionService,
    crashReportingDriver: CrashReportingDriver,
    ioDispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher,
    mainContext: CoroutineContext,
    isDebug: Boolean,
    releaseStoreFactory: StoreFactory,
    debugStoreFactory: StoreFactory,
    lifecycleRegistry: LifecycleRegistry = LifecycleRegistry(),
    nowEpochMillis: () -> Long = { Clock.System.now().toEpochMilliseconds() },
    private val timeZone: () -> TimeZone = { TimeZone.currentSystemDefault() },
    dailyEvaluationEnabled: Boolean = false,
    summaryHorizonDays: Int = 1,
    flushPreferences: () -> Unit = {},
) : AutoCloseable {
    private val lifecycleRegistry = lifecycleRegistry.also { it.create() }
    private val database = LocalDatabase(driverFactory, ioDispatcher)
    val productSettings: ProductSettings = MultiplatformProductSettings(settings)
    private val applicationScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + ioDispatcher)
    private val crashReportingCoordinator = CrashReportingCoordinator(
        productSettings,
        crashReportingDriver,
        if (isDebug) RuntimeEnvironment.DEBUG else RuntimeEnvironment.RELEASE,
    )
    private val mutableCrashReportingState = MutableStateFlow(crashReportingCoordinator.applyPreference(false))
    private val reminderPlanSource = SnapshotReminderPlanSource(
        snapshot = { database.snapshot() },
        settings = productSettings,
        nowEpochMillis = nowEpochMillis,
        timeZone = timeZone,
        dailyEvaluationEnabled = dailyEvaluationEnabled,
        summaryHorizonDays = summaryHorizonDays,
    )
    private val reminderCoordinator = ReminderLifecycleCoordinator(
        permissionService = notificationPermissionService,
        planSource = reminderPlanSource,
        reconciler = ReminderReconciler(reminderDriver),
        clock = EpochMillisClock(nowEpochMillis),
    )
    private val reminderPort = SnapshotReminderReconciliationPort(reminderCoordinator)
    private val reminderScheduling = ReminderSchedulingMonitor()
    private val workspaceRepository = LocalWorkspaceRepository(database, privateFileStore, ioDispatcher)
    private lateinit var rootComponent: AppRootComponent
    private val rootConstructed = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    private val backupService = LocalBackupService(
        database = database,
        files = privateFileStore,
        settings = productSettings,
        ioDispatcher = ioDispatcher,
        documents = documentPort,
        reminders = reminderPort,
        output = FirstRunNavigationOutput(mainContext) { rootComponent.resetToFirstRun() },
        csvHeaders = { localizedCsvHeaders() },
        flushPreferences = flushPreferences,
        clearPendingPhotos = { pendingPhotoImportStore.clear() },
    )
    private val productionDataManager = ProductionScreenDataManager(
        database = database,
        settings = productSettings,
        workspaceRepository = workspaceRepository,
        backupService = backupService,
        pendingPhotos = pendingPhotoImportStore,
        now = { kotlinx.datetime.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(nowEpochMillis()) },
        today = { kotlinx.datetime.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(nowEpochMillis()).toLocalDateTime(timeZone()).date },
        timeZone = timeZone,
    )
    private val workspaceRecovery = WorkspaceRecoveryGate(applicationScope) {
        rootConstructed.await()
        backupService.recoverPendingReplacement()
        if (!database.hasMinimumGrowingSetup()) {
            withContext(mainContext) { rootComponent.resetToFirstRun() }
        }
    }
    private val screenDataManager = RecoveryGatedScreenDataManager(ReminderAwareScreenDataManager(
        delegate = CrashAwareScreenDataManager(productionDataManager, mutableCrashReportingState.asStateFlow()),
        settings = productSettings,
        permissionService = notificationPermissionService,
        reconcile = ::reconcile,
        schedulingState = reminderScheduling.state,
    ), workspaceRecovery)
    private var closed = false

    private val productionRoot: AppRootComponent = AppRootFactory(
        productionRootDependencies(
            releaseStoreFactory = releaseStoreFactory,
            debugStoreFactory = debugStoreFactory,
            isDebug = isDebug,
            screenDataManager = screenDataManager,
            mainContext = mainContext,
            initialScreen = ScreenId.TODAY,
        ),
    ).create(DefaultComponentContext(lifecycleRegistry)).also {
        rootComponent = it
        rootConstructed.complete(Unit)
    }
    val root: AppRootComponent = ThemedAppRootComponent(productionRoot, productSettings.theme)
    val workspaceReady: StateFlow<Boolean> get() = workspaceRecovery.ready

    val lifecycleState: Lifecycle.State get() = lifecycleRegistry.state

    init {
        applicationScope.launch { runCatching { pendingPhotoImportStore.clear() } }
        applicationScope.launch {
            workspaceRecovery.ready.first { it }
            productSettings.crashReportingEnabled.collect { preference ->
                mutableCrashReportingState.value = crashReportingCoordinator.applyPreference(preference)
            }
        }
        reconcile(ReconciliationReason.APP_START)
    }

    fun onStart() = lifecycleRegistry.start()
    fun onResume() {
        lifecycleRegistry.resume()
        applicationScope.launch {
            reminderScheduling.run {
                workspaceRecovery.awaitReady()
                reminderCoordinator.onHostResume()
            }
        }
    }
    fun onPause() = lifecycleRegistry.pause()
    fun onStop() = lifecycleRegistry.stop()

    fun requestNotificationPermission() {
        applicationScope.launch {
            reminderScheduling.run {
                workspaceRecovery.awaitReady()
                notificationPermissionService.request()
                reminderCoordinator.reconcile(ReconciliationReason.PERMISSION_RESTORED)
            }
        }
    }

    fun reconcile(reason: ReconciliationReason) {
        applicationScope.launch {
            reminderScheduling.run {
                workspaceRecovery.awaitReady()
                reminderCoordinator.reconcile(reason)
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun reconcileReminderEnvironment(reason: ReconciliationReason) {
        workspaceRecovery.awaitReady()
        reconcileReminderEnvironment(reason, productionDataManager, reminderCoordinator, timeZone())
    }

    suspend fun evaluateReminderDelivery(id: PhysicalReminderId, fireAtEpochMillis: Long): Boolean {
        workspaceRecovery.awaitReady()
        return reminderCoordinator.onDelivery {
            notificationPermissionService.check() == PermissionState.Granted &&
                reminderPlanSource.shouldDeliver(id, fireAtEpochMillis)
        }
    }

    override fun close() {
        if (closed) return
        closed = true
        applicationScope.cancel()
        lifecycleRegistry.destroy()
        pendingPhotoImportStore.close()
        privateFileStore.close()
        database.close()
    }
}

internal class CrashAwareScreenDataManager(
    private val delegate: ScreenDataManager,
    private val runtimeState: StateFlow<CrashReportingState>,
) : ScreenDataManager {
    override suspend fun previewStage(command: ScreenCommand) = delegate.previewStage(command)

    override fun watch(screen: ScreenId, stableId: String?): Flow<ScreenSnapshot> {
        val source = delegate.watch(screen, stableId)
        if (screen != ScreenId.SETTINGS) return source
        return combine(source, runtimeState) { snapshot, state -> snapshot.withCrashReporting(state) }
    }

    override suspend fun execute(screen: ScreenId, command: ScreenCommand): Result<ScreenSnapshot> =
        delegate.execute(screen, command).map { snapshot ->
            if (screen == ScreenId.SETTINGS) snapshot.withCrashReporting(runtimeState.value) else snapshot
        }

}

internal class SnapshotReminderReconciliationPort(
    private val coordinator: ReminderLifecycleCoordinator?,
    private val legacyDriver: ReminderDriver? = null,
    private val legacyNowEpochMillis: (() -> Long)? = null,
) : ReminderReconciliationPort {
    constructor(coordinator: ReminderLifecycleCoordinator) : this(coordinator, null, null)
    constructor(driver: ReminderDriver, nowEpochMillis: () -> Long) : this(null, driver, nowEpochMillis)

    override suspend fun replaceFutureReminders(snapshot: ProductSnapshot) {
        coordinator?.onRestoreCompleted()?.requireSuccessful() ?: run {
            val driver = requireNotNull(legacyDriver)
            val desired = snapshot.futureSoakReminders(requireNotNull(legacyNowEpochMillis).invoke()).associateBy { it.id }
            val existing = driver.registeredIds()
            (existing - desired.keys).sortedBy { it.value }.forEach { driver.cancel(it).getOrThrow() }
            desired.values.sortedBy { it.id.value }.forEach { driver.schedule(it).getOrThrow() }
        }
    }
}

internal class SnapshotReminderPlanSource(
    private val snapshot: suspend () -> ProductSnapshot,
    private val settings: com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.data.ProductSettings,
    private val nowEpochMillis: () -> Long,
    private val timeZone: () -> TimeZone,
    private val dailyEvaluationEnabled: Boolean = false,
    private val summaryHorizonDays: Int = 1,
) : ReminderPlanSource {
    override suspend fun currentPlan(): ReminderPlan {
        val now = nowEpochMillis()
        val current = snapshot()
        val preferences = settings.snapshot()
        val dueCount = current.pendingWorkCountAt(now)
        val summaryAt = nextSummaryAt(now, preferences.summaryTime, timeZone())
        val windowWorkCount = current.pendingWorkCountAt(summaryAt)
        val daily = if (preferences.notificationsEnabled && (dailyEvaluationEnabled || windowWorkCount > 0)) {
            PhysicalReminder(
                id = PhysicalReminderId(DAILY_SUMMARY_ID),
                kind = ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY,
                fireAtEpochMillis = summaryAt,
                titleKey = NativeTextKey.DAILY_SUMMARY_TITLE,
                bodyKey = NativeTextKey.DAILY_SUMMARY_BODY,
            )
        } else null
        val soak = if (preferences.soakRemindersEnabled) current.futureSoakReminders(now) else emptyList()
        if (summaryHorizonDays <= 1 || dailyEvaluationEnabled) {
            return ReminderPlan(dueCount, daily, soak, windowWorkCount, dailyEvaluationEnabled)
        }
        val summaries = if (preferences.notificationsEnabled) {
            current.summaryWindows(summaryAt, preferences.summaryTime)
        } else emptyList()
        return ReminderPlan(dueCount, null, soak, windowWorkCount, dailySummaries = summaries)
    }

    private fun ProductSnapshot.summaryWindows(firstAt: Long, summaryTime: SummaryLocalTime): List<PhysicalReminder> {
        val zone = timeZone()
        val firstDate = kotlinx.datetime.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(firstAt).toLocalDateTime(zone).date
        return (0 until summaryHorizonDays).mapNotNull { offset ->
            val date = firstDate.plus(offset, DateTimeUnit.DAY)
            val civil = LocalDateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day, summaryTime.hour, summaryTime.minute)
            val fireAt = civil.toInstant(zone).toEpochMilliseconds()
            if (pendingWorkCountAt(fireAt) == 0) null else PhysicalReminder(
                PhysicalReminderId("$DAILY_SUMMARY_ID:$date"), ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY, fireAt,
                NativeTextKey.DAILY_SUMMARY_TITLE, NativeTextKey.DAILY_SUMMARY_BODY, civil,
            )
        }
    }

    suspend fun shouldDeliver(id: PhysicalReminderId, fireAtEpochMillis: Long): Boolean {
        val now = nowEpochMillis()
        if (fireAtEpochMillis > now) return false
        val current = snapshot()
        val preferences = settings.snapshot()
        if (id.value == DAILY_SUMMARY_ID) {
            val zone = timeZone()
            val today = kotlinx.datetime.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(now).toLocalDateTime(zone).date
            val currentWindow = LocalDateTime(today.year, today.month, today.day,
                preferences.summaryTime.hour, preferences.summaryTime.minute).toInstant(zone).toEpochMilliseconds()
            return preferences.notificationsEnabled && fireAtEpochMillis == currentWindow &&
                current.pendingWorkCountAt(now) > 0
        }
        return preferences.soakRemindersEnabled && current.batches.filterNot { it.state.isTerminal }.any { batch ->
            batch.effectiveActions().any { action ->
                action.status == ScheduledActionStatus.PENDING && action.isSoakReminder(batch.id.value) &&
                    action.due is com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.DueMoment.ElapsedTarget &&
                    id.value == "sproutpace:soak:${batch.id.value}:${action.id.value}" &&
                    SchedulingEngine.resolvedInstant(action).toEpochMilliseconds() == fireAtEpochMillis
            }
        }
    }

    private fun ProductSnapshot.pendingWorkCountAt(at: Long): Int = batches.asSequence()
        .filterNot { it.state.isTerminal }
        .flatMap { it.effectiveActions().asSequence() }
        .count { action ->
            action.status == ScheduledActionStatus.PENDING && SchedulingEngine.resolvedInstant(
                SchedulingEngine.afterTimeZoneChange(action, timeZone().id),
            ).toEpochMilliseconds() <= at
        }

    private fun nextSummaryAt(now: Long, localTime: SummaryLocalTime, zone: TimeZone): Long {
        val nowLocal = kotlinx.datetime.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(now).toLocalDateTime(zone)
        var date = nowLocal.date
        var candidate = LocalDateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day, localTime.hour, localTime.minute)
            .toInstant(zone).toEpochMilliseconds()
        if (candidate <= now) {
            date = date.plus(1, DateTimeUnit.DAY)
            candidate = LocalDateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day, localTime.hour, localTime.minute)
                .toInstant(zone).toEpochMilliseconds()
        }
        return candidate
    }

    private companion object {
        const val DAILY_SUMMARY_ID = "sproutpace:daily-summary"
    }
}

internal class ReminderAwareScreenDataManager(
    private val delegate: ScreenDataManager,
    private val settings: com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.data.ProductSettings,
    private val permissionService: NotificationPermissionService,
    private val reconcile: (ReconciliationReason) -> Unit,
    private val schedulingState: StateFlow<ReminderSchedulingState> = MutableStateFlow(ReminderSchedulingState.IDLE),
) : ScreenDataManager {
    override suspend fun previewStage(command: ScreenCommand) = delegate.previewStage(command)

    override fun watch(screen: ScreenId, stableId: String?): Flow<ScreenSnapshot> {
        val source = delegate.watch(screen, stableId)
        if (screen in PERMISSION_CONTEXT_SCREENS) {
            val enabled = combine(settings.notificationsEnabled, settings.soakRemindersEnabled) { daily, soak ->
                daily || soak
            }
            return combine(source, enabled, permissionService.state) { snapshot, remindersEnabled, permission ->
                snapshot.withNotificationPermissionContext(remindersEnabled, permission.toComponentPermissionState())
            }
        }
        if (screen != ScreenId.NOTIFICATIONS) return source
        val preferences = combine(
            settings.notificationsEnabled,
            settings.summaryTime,
            settings.soakRemindersEnabled,
        ) { daily, time, soak -> Triple(daily, time, soak) }
        val notificationState = combine(source, preferences, permissionService.state) { snapshot, values, permission ->
            snapshot.copy(
                items = listOf(
                    ScreenItem("daily-summary", titleKey = TextKey("notifications_daily_summary"), stateKey = booleanKey(values.first)),
                    ScreenItem("summary-time", titleKey = TextKey("notifications_time"), authoredTitle = values.second.toString()),
                    ScreenItem("soak-reminder", titleKey = TextKey("notifications_soak_reminder"), stateKey = booleanKey(values.third)),
                ),
                permissionState = permission.toComponentPermissionState(),
                actions = snapshot.actions.filter { action ->
                    action.id.value in notificationPermissionActionIds(values.first || values.third, permission)
                },
            )
        }
        return combine(notificationState, schedulingState) { snapshot, state -> snapshot.withReminderScheduling(state) }
    }

    override suspend fun execute(screen: ScreenId, command: ScreenCommand): Result<ScreenSnapshot> =
        delegate.execute(screen, command).fold(
            onSuccess = { snapshot ->
                if (command.operation in REMINDER_MUTATIONS || command.operation == "update-notifications") {
                    reconcile(ReconciliationReason.PRODUCT_DATA_CHANGED)
                }
                val projected = when (screen) {
                    ScreenId.NOTIFICATIONS -> watch(screen, command.subjectId).first()
                    in PERMISSION_CONTEXT_SCREENS -> snapshot.withNotificationPermissionContext(
                        settings.notificationsEnabled.value || settings.soakRemindersEnabled.value,
                        permissionService.state.value.toComponentPermissionState(),
                    )
                    else -> snapshot
                }
                Result.success(projected)
            },
            onFailure = { Result.failure(it) },
        )

    private fun booleanKey(value: Boolean) = TextKey(if (value) "state_enabled" else "state_disabled")

    private fun PermissionState.toComponentPermissionState() = when (this) {
        PermissionState.Unknown, PermissionState.Checking, PermissionState.Requesting ->
            com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.PermissionState.NOT_REQUESTED
        PermissionState.Granted -> com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.PermissionState.GRANTED
        is PermissionState.Denied -> if (canRequestAgain) {
            com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.PermissionState.DENIED
        } else {
            com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.PermissionState.PERMANENTLY_DENIED
        }
        PermissionState.Unavailable -> com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.PermissionState.NOT_REQUIRED
    }

    private companion object {
        val PERMISSION_CONTEXT_SCREENS = setOf(ScreenId.SETTINGS, ScreenId.FIRST_RUN, ScreenId.TODAY)
        val REMINDER_MUTATIONS = setOf(
            "save-batch", "delete-batch", "delete-batch-cascade", "confirm-sowing", "confirm-stage",
            "undo-stage", "skip-stage", "complete-action", "snooze", "skip-action", "schedule-soak-target",
            "time-zone-change", "close-harvest", "close-failed", "close-abandoned", "save-outcome",
        )
    }
}

private fun ProductSnapshot.futureSoakReminders(nowEpochMillis: Long): List<PhysicalReminder> =
    batches.filterNot { it.state.isTerminal }.flatMap { batch ->
        batch.effectiveActions().mapNotNull { action ->
            val fireAt = SchedulingEngine.resolvedInstant(action).toEpochMilliseconds()
            if (action.status != ScheduledActionStatus.PENDING || !action.isSoakReminder(batch.id.value) ||
                action.due !is com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.DueMoment.ElapsedTarget || fireAt <= nowEpochMillis
            ) {
                null
            } else {
                PhysicalReminder(
                    id = PhysicalReminderId("sproutpace:soak:${batch.id.value}:${action.id.value}"),
                    kind = ReminderKind.SOAK,
                    fireAtEpochMillis = fireAt,
                    titleKey = NativeTextKey.SOAK_COMPLETE_TITLE,
                    bodyKey = NativeTextKey.SOAK_COMPLETE_BODY,
                )
            }
        }
    }

private fun ScheduledAction.isSoakReminder(batchId: String): Boolean =
    kind == com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.domain.model.ScheduledActionKind.SOAK_TARGET ||
        stage == GrowStage.SOAKING || (stage == null && id.value == "soak:$batchId")

/** Pure assembly seam used by contract tests without constructing production storage. */
internal fun productionRootDependencies(
    releaseStoreFactory: StoreFactory,
    debugStoreFactory: StoreFactory,
    isDebug: Boolean,
    screenDataManager: ScreenDataManager,
    mainContext: CoroutineContext,
    initialScreen: ScreenId = ScreenId.TODAY,
): AppRootDependencies = AppRootDependencies(
    releaseStoreFactory = releaseStoreFactory,
    debugStoreFactory = debugStoreFactory,
    isDebug = isDebug,
    screenDataManager = screenDataManager,
    mainContext = mainContext,
    initialScreen = initialScreen,
)

name: Analysis and test

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: analysis-and-test-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  android-quality:
    name: Android, quality, and screenshots
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@9c971963bec38e04b3d30dcc455b5382be2fdbfb # v6.3.0
        with:
          cache-provider: basic

      - name: Make Gradle wrapper executable
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Run Android and repository gates
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --stacktrace
          detekt
          :shared:domain:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:data:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:component:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:root:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:platform:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:monetization:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:compose:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:compose:compileAndroidMain
          :shared:data:verifySqlDelightMigration
          :androidApp:assembleDebug
          :androidApp:assembleRelease
          :androidApp:bundleRelease
          koverXmlReport
          koverVerify

      - name: Verify committed Paparazzi baselines
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --stacktrace --no-configuration-cache
          :shared:compose:verifyPaparazzi

      - name: Upload quality reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: android-quality-reports
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: |
            build/reports/detekt/**
            build/reports/kover/**
            shared/*/build/test-results/**
            shared/*/build/reports/tests/**
            shared/compose/build/reports/paparazzi/**

      - name: Upload screenshot failures
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: paparazzi-failures
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: shared/compose/build/paparazzi/failures/**

  ios:
    name: iOS compile, tests, framework, and app linkage
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@9c971963bec38e04b3d30dcc455b5382be2fdbfb # v6.3.0
        with:
          cache-provider: basic

      - name: Make Gradle wrapper executable
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Compile and test Kotlin iOS targets
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --stacktrace
          :shared:domain:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:data:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:component:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:root:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:platform:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:monetization:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:compose:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:domain:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:data:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:component:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:root:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:platform:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:monetization:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:compose:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:domain:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:data:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:component:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:root:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:platform:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:monetization:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:compose:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:compose:linkDebugFrameworkIosSimulatorArm64

      - name: Build the iOS host without signing
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/ios-ci
          xcodebuild \
            -project iosApp/iosApp.xcodeproj \
            -scheme iosApp \
            -configuration Debug \
            -sdk iphonesimulator \
            -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' \
            -resultBundlePath build/ios-ci/SproutPace.xcresult \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
            build

      - name: Upload iOS test and build reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: ios-test-and-build-reports
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: |
            shared/*/build/test-results/**
            shared/*/build/reports/tests/**
            build/ios-ci/**

val yandexProductionAdUnitId = providers.gradleProperty("sproutpace.yandex.android.adUnitId").orElse("")

val publicationSigningStoreFile = providers.gradleProperty("sproutpace.signing.storeFile").orElse("")

val publicationSigningKeyPassword = providers.gradleProperty("sproutpace.signing.keyPassword").orElse("")

val configuredPrivacyPolicyUrl = providers.provider {
    val path = privacyConfigurationFile.get().trim()
    if (path.isEmpty()) return@provider ""
    val file = rootProject.file(path)
    if (!file.isFile) return@provider ""
    val value = runCatching {
        Properties().apply { file.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use(::load) }
            .getProperty("privacyPolicy.url")
            .orEmpty()
            .trim()
    }.getOrDefault("")
    val uri = runCatching { URI(value) }.getOrNull()
    value.takeIf {
        uri?.scheme.equals("https", ignoreCase = true) &&
            !uri?.host.isNullOrBlank() &&
            !it.contains("REPLACE_WITH", ignoreCase = true)
    }.orEmpty()
}

if (firebaseCrashlyticsEnabled) {
    apply(plugin = "com.google.gms.google-services")
    apply(plugin = "com.google.firebase.crashlytics")
}

val validateYandexReleaseAdUnit by tasks.registering {
    group = "verification"
    description = "Validates the external Yandex ID before an advertising-enabled publication."
    doLast {
        val value = yandexProductionAdUnitId.get().trim()
        check(value.matches(Regex("R-M-[0-9]+-[0-9]+"))) {
            "Set -Psproutpace.yandex.android.adUnitId=R-M-<digits>-<digits> before publication."
        }
        check(value != "demo-banner-yandex") { "The Yandex demo ad unit is forbidden in release builds." }
    }
}

val validateAndroidPublicationReadiness by tasks.registering {
    group = "verification"
    description = "Validates external Android publication values without signing or publishing an artifact."
    dependsOn(validateYandexReleaseAdUnit)

    doLast {
        val privacyPath = privacyConfigurationFile.get().trim()
        check(privacyPath.isNotEmpty()) {
            "Set -Psproutpace.privacy.propertiesFile to the approved UTF-8 privacy properties file."
        }
        val privacyFile = rootProject.file(privacyPath)
        check(privacyFile.isFile) { "Privacy properties file does not exist: $privacyPath" }
        check(
            privacyFile.canonicalFile !=
                rootProject.file("docs/configuration/advertising/privacy-policy.example.properties").canonicalFile,
        ) { "The repository example is a template, not approved publication copy." }

        val privacy = Properties().apply {
            privacyFile.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use(::load)
        }
        val requiredPrivacyKeys = listOf(
            "privacyPolicy.url",
            "consent.en.title",
            "consent.en.body",
            "consent.en.accept",
            "consent.en.decline",
            "consent.en.policyLink",
            "consent.en.withdraw",
            "consent.ru.title",
            "consent.ru.body",
            "consent.ru.accept",
            "consent.ru.decline",
            "consent.ru.policyLink",
            "consent.ru.withdraw",
            "disclosure.en.adLabel",
            "disclosure.ru.adLabel",
        )
        requiredPrivacyKeys.forEach { key ->
            val value = privacy.getProperty(key).orEmpty().trim()
            check(value.isNotEmpty() && !value.contains("REPLACE_WITH", ignoreCase = true)) {
                "Approved privacy configuration is missing a final value for '$key'."
            }
        }
        val privacyPolicyUri = runCatching { URI(privacy.getProperty("privacyPolicy.url").trim()) }.getOrNull()
        check(privacyPolicyUri?.let { it.scheme == "https" && !it.host.isNullOrBlank() } == true) {
            "privacyPolicy.url must be a final public HTTPS URL."
        }

        val signingStorePath = publicationSigningStoreFile.get().trim()
        check(signingStorePath.isNotEmpty()) {
            "Set -Psproutpace.signing.storeFile to the external Android upload keystore."
        }
        check(rootProject.file(signingStorePath).isFile) {
            "Android upload keystore does not exist: $signingStorePath"
        }
        mapOf(
            "sproutpace.signing.storePassword" to publicationSigningStorePassword.get(),
            "sproutpace.signing.keyAlias" to publicationSigningKeyAlias.get(),
            "sproutpace.signing.keyPassword" to publicationSigningKeyPassword.get(),
        ).forEach { (property, value) ->
            check(value.isNotBlank()) { "Set -P$property before publication." }
        }
    }
}

package com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.compose

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.File

class AccessibilityContractTest {
    @Test
    fun interactiveRendererDeclaresMinimumTargetsRolesErrorsAndStateDescriptions() {
        val source = projectFile(
            "src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/ScreenContent.kt",
            "shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/ScreenContent.kt",
        ).readText()
        assertTrue("48dp minimum targets", source.contains("heightIn(min = 48.dp)"))
        assertTrue("switch role", source.contains("role = Role.Switch"))
        assertTrue("radio role", source.contains("role = Role.RadioButton"))
        assertTrue("checkbox role", source.contains("role = Role.Checkbox"))
        assertTrue("validation error semantics", source.contains("error(text)"))
        assertTrue("state descriptions", source.contains("stateDescription ="))
        assertTrue("dynamic status announcements", source.contains("liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite"))
        assertTrue("headings", source.contains("heading()"))
        assertTrue("context inputs are expandable", source.contains("toggle-context-fields"))
        assertTrue("destructive actions use error color", source.contains("contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error"))
        assertTrue(
            "facts and actions precede edit mechanics",
            source.indexOf("actionItems(state, onAction)") < source.indexOf("fieldItems(state, contextFieldsExpanded"),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun englishAndRussianProductionResourcesHaveIdenticalKeys() {
        val english = resourceKeys(
            projectFile(
                "src/commonMain/composeResources/values/strings.xml",
                "shared/compose/src/commonMain/composeResources/values/strings.xml",
            ),
        )
        val russian = resourceKeys(
            projectFile(
                "src/commonMain/composeResources/values-ru/strings.xml",
                "shared/compose/src/commonMain/composeResources/values-ru/strings.xml",
            ),
        )
        assertEquals("EN/RU resource keys must remain lossless", english, russian)
    }

    @Test
    fun productionRendererHasNoSampleOnlyTextPath() {
        val productionSources = listOf("App.kt", "RootUiAdapter.kt", "ScreenContent.kt").joinToString("\n") { name ->
            projectFile(
                "src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/$name",
                "shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/$name",
            ).readText()
        }
        assertTrue("sample_* keys must not drive production UI", !Regex("sample_[a-z0-9_]+").containsMatchIn(productionSources))
    }

    @Test
    fun productionScreensDoNotRequireTimeBasedMotionToCommunicateState() {
        val productionSources = listOf("App.kt", "ScreenContent.kt").joinToString("\n") { name ->
            projectFile(
                "src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/$name",
                "shared/compose/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/compose/$name",
            ).readText()
        }
        val timeBasedMotionApis = listOf(
            "AnimatedContent(",
            "AnimatedVisibility(",
            "animateColorAsState(",
            "animateDpAsState(",
            "animateFloatAsState(",
            "animateItem(",
            "rememberInfiniteTransition(",
        )
        timeBasedMotionApis.forEach { api ->
            assertFalse("Production state must remain understandable with reduced motion: $api", productionSources.contains(api))
        }
    }

    private fun resourceKeys(file: File): Set<String> =
        file.parentFile.listFiles().orEmpty().filter { it.extension == "xml" }.flatMap { resource ->
            Regex("<string name=\"([^\"]+)\"").findAll(resource.readText()).map { it.groupValues[1] }.toList()
        }.toSet()

    private fun projectFile(vararg candidates: String): File =
        candidates.asSequence().map(::File).firstOrNull(File::isFile)
            ?: error("Missing project file; tried ${candidates.joinToString()}")
}

data class ScreenComponentDependencies(
    val storeFactory: StoreFactory,
    val manager: ScreenDataManager,
    val mainContext: CoroutineContext,
)

abstract class StoredScreenComponent(
    componentContext: ComponentContext,
    private val screen: ScreenId,
    stableId: String?,
    dependencies: ScreenComponentDependencies,
    private val output: (ScreenOutput) -> Unit,
) : ScreenComponent, ComponentContext by componentContext {
    private val restoredDraft = stateKeeper.consume("screen-draft", SavedScreenDraft.serializer())
    private val store = instanceKeeper.getStore(key = "${screen.name}:${stableId.orEmpty()}") {
        ScreenStoreProvider(
            dependencies.storeFactory, dependencies.manager, screen, stableId, dependencies.mainContext,
            restoredDraft = restoredDraft,
        ).provide()
    }

    override val model: Value<ScreenModel> = StoreValue(store) { it.toModel() }

    init {
        stateKeeper.register("screen-draft", SavedScreenDraft.serializer()) {
            SavedScreenDraft(store.state.draftValues.mapKeys { it.key.value },
                store.state.dirtyFields.mapTo(mutableSetOf()) { it.value }, store.state.snapshot.selectedItemId)
        }
        val disposable = store.labels(observer(onNext = { label ->
            when (label) {
                is ScreenStore.Label.Completed -> output(ScreenOutput.Completed(label.command.operation, label.command.subjectId))
                is ScreenStore.Label.ConfirmationRequested -> output(
                    ScreenOutput.ConfirmationRequested(
                        sourceScreen = screen,
                        command = label.command,
                        destructiveOperation = requireNotNull(label.command.destructiveOperation),
                    ),
                )
            }
        }))
        lifecycle.subscribe(object : com.arkivanov.essenty.lifecycle.Lifecycle.Callbacks {
            override fun onDestroy() {
                disposable.dispose()
                stateKeeper.unregister("screen-draft")
            }
        })
    }

    override fun onAction(action: ScreenAction) {
        when (action) {
            ScreenAction.Back -> output(ScreenOutput.Back)
            ScreenAction.Retry -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.Retry)
            is ScreenAction.ReportFailure -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.ReportFailure(action.key))
            is ScreenAction.Select -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.Select(action.id))
            is ScreenAction.EditField -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.EditField(action.fieldId, action.value))
            is ScreenAction.ChooseOption -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.EditField(action.fieldId, action.optionId))
            is ScreenAction.Submit -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.Submit(action.actionId))
            ScreenAction.CancelDraft -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.CancelDraft)
            ScreenAction.ConfirmStagePreview -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.ConfirmStagePreview)
            is ScreenAction.SetLayout -> store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.SetLayout(action.mode))
            is ScreenAction.Execute -> {
                val destructiveOperation = action.command.destructiveOperation
                if (destructiveOperation == null) {
                    store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.Execute(action.command))
                } else {
                    output(ScreenOutput.ConfirmationRequested(screen, action.command, destructiveOperation))
                }
            }
            is ScreenAction.ExecuteConfirmed -> {
                requireNotNull(action.command.destructiveOperation) { "Only classified destructive commands may use the confirmed path" }
                store.accept(ScreenStore.Intent.Execute(action.command))
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun ScreenStore.State.toModel(): ScreenModel {
    val contract = ScreenContractRegistry.contracts.getValue(screen)
    val sourceFields = if (snapshot.hasInteractionContract) snapshot.fields else snapshot.fields.ifEmpty { contract.fields }
    val fields = sourceFields.map { value -> value.copy(value = draftValues[value.id] ?: value.value) }
    val facts = if (snapshot.hasInteractionContract) snapshot.facts else snapshot.facts.ifEmpty { contract.facts }
    val actions = if (snapshot.hasInteractionContract) snapshot.actions else snapshot.actions.ifEmpty { contract.actions }
    return ScreenModel(
        screen = screen,
        loadState = when {
            loading -> LoadState.LOADING
            errorKey != null -> LoadState.ERROR
            ScreenVariant.EMPTY in contract.variants && snapshot.items.isEmpty() -> LoadState.EMPTY
            else -> LoadState.CONTENT
        },
        titleKey = titleKey(screen),
        items = snapshot.items,
        selectedItemId = snapshot.selectedItemId,
        plans = snapshot.plans,
        primaryActionKey = snapshot.primaryActionKey,
        errorKey = errorKey,
        permissionState = snapshot.permissionState,
        conflictResolutionKeys = snapshot.conflictResolutionKeys,
        offline = snapshot.offline,
        busy = busy,
        }

        private fun observe() {
            observation?.cancel()
            observation = scope.launch {
                manager.watch(screen, stableId).collectLatest {
                    dispatch(Msg.Loaded(it, preferences.flatMap { request -> request.revisions.keys }.toSet()))
                    observeDetail(state().snapshot.selectedItemId)
                }
            }
        }

        private fun observeDetail(subjectId: String?) {
            val detailScreen = when (screen) {
                ScreenId.TRAYS -> ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL
                ScreenId.CATALOG -> ScreenId.RECIPE
                else -> return
            }
            if (detailSubject == subjectId) return
            detailSubject = subjectId
            detailObservation?.cancel()
            if (subjectId == null) return
            detailObservation = scope.launch {
                manager.watch(detailScreen, subjectId).collectLatest { dispatch(Msg.DetailLoaded(subjectId, it)) }
            }
        }

        private fun executePreference(command: ScreenCommand) {
            if (command.invocationId != null && command.executionKey in completedKeys) return

        fun valid(choice: ConsentChoice = ConsentChoice.ACCEPTED) = AdvertisingPrivacyState(
            policyVersion = "policy-7",
            fetchedAtEpochMillis = Instant.parse(NOW).toEpochMilliseconds() - 1_000,
            expiresAtEpochMillis = Instant.parse(NOW).toEpochMilliseconds() + 1_000,
            choice = choice,
        )
        suspend fun ids() = manager.watch(ScreenId.SETTINGS).first().items.map { it.id }

        assertFalse("privacy" in ids())
        settings.setPrivacyState(valid())
        assertTrue("privacy" in ids())
        assertEquals(
            "open-advertising-privacy",
            manager.watch(ScreenId.SETTINGS).first().items.single { it.id == "privacy" }.actionId,
        )
        settings.setPrivacyState(valid(ConsentChoice.WITHDRAWN))
        assertTrue("privacy" in ids())
        settings.setPrivacyState(valid().copy(expiresAtEpochMillis = Instant.parse(NOW).toEpochMilliseconds()))
        assertFalse("privacy" in ids())
        settings.setPrivacyState(valid().copy(consentRequired = false))
        assertFalse("privacy" in ids())
    }

# SCREEN-007 - Catalog

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-004, FLOW-006, FLOW-010, FLOW-012  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-004, REQ-006, REQ-010, REQ-012

## Purpose and hierarchy

Browse eight bundled culture guides and personal recipes, open details, and create a personal recipe. The bundled catalog remains readable offline and identifies source/version/review metadata.

## States

- Content: bundled and personal recipe cards in feed/grid form.
- Search/filter result empty state; catalog itself is never network-empty.
- Local loading/error for personal data only.
- Offline: all recipes remain available and the ad slot collapses.
- Ad state: one eligible inline item after four real culture cards.

## Actions and iconography

Cards open SCREEN-008; Create personal recipe is labeled. Search/filter, favorite if specified later, source info, and personal edit use standard icons with semantics. ASSET-022-029 visually distinguish the eight bundled cultures.

## Text layout expectations

Common localized culture name is primary; scientific name, typical window, and source metadata are secondary. Names wrap before truncation. Ad label and recipe provenance are explicit complete strings.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact uses one/two columns according to available width; expanded uses a grid with optional detail pane. Cards have one clear click target and separate accessible overflow only when needed. Images with redundant names are decorative. Scaffold owns insets.

## Allowed ad slots

One labeled inline Yandex ad after the fourth culture card, only on eligible Android visits with sufficient content. Hidden state occupies zero space.

## Asset requirements

ASSET-022, ASSET-023, ASSET-024, ASSET-025, ASSET-026, ASSET-027, ASSET-028, ASSET-029; standard search, filter, add, source, and edit icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

EN compact catalog light/dark; RU 200%; expanded grid; personal recipes; search-empty; offline hidden-ad; eligible ad; missing optional image fallback; long personal recipe name.
# SCREEN-008 - Recipe detail and editor

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-004, FLOW-006  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-004, REQ-006

## Purpose and hierarchy

Read a bundled guide or create/edit a personal recipe with stage guidance, typical ranges, source links, review date, and a simple local version. Built-in content is read-only; personal content is editable.

## States

- Bundled detail with provenance and Use recipe.
- Personal create/edit with validation.
- Outdated-review metadata warning without external approval workflow.
- Local save/delete failure with retained input.
- Offline: content and editing work; external source link reports connectivity only when opened.

## Actions and iconography

Use recipe opens SCREEN-004; Save, Edit, Duplicate, Delete, and Open source appear by mode. Use labeled Material actions and standard edit/copy/delete/link icons. No signature, approver, or attestation control exists.

## Text layout expectations

Stage ranges always pair value and unit. Source title/URL may wrap; version and review date remain readable. EN/RU built-in content uses shared resource keys; personal content is preserved verbatim.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact stacks culture header, stages, and provenance. Expanded places structured stages beside supporting metadata/editor. Form errors are programmatically associated; links state destination. One scaffold owns insets.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Applicable ASSET-022-029 culture cover; ASSET-016-020 stage vectors; standard edit, copy, delete, source, save, and navigation icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Bundled radish detail light/dark; garden cress RU 200%; personal create/edit; invalid range; overdue review warning; long source URL; offline source-open failure; expanded stages.
# SCREEN-009 - Observation editor

Linked flows: FLOW-007  
Linked requirements: REQ-007

## Purpose and hierarchy

Add or edit a dated observation with optional note and one optional app-owned photo selected through the system picker.

## States

- Create/edit content with date, note, and photo preview.
- Photo absent, selected, replaced, or removed.
- Picker permission/failure explanation that preserves text.
- Validation and local save failure with retry.
- Offline: fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Save is primary; Choose/Replace photo, Remove photo, Delete observation, and Cancel are labeled. Use standard photo, date, save, delete, and navigation icons; photo thumbnails never become unlabeled controls.

## Text layout expectations

User notes preserve entered language and line breaks. Date follows system locale. At 200% supporting/error text wraps below its field; destructive labels remain complete.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact uses a scrolling form; expanded gives the photo a bounded supporting pane. Picker use is not the only path to save. Preview has a useful description derived from localized context, not image diagnosis. Scaffold owns insets once.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard photo, date, save, delete, and back icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Empty create light/dark; note plus photo; edit; RU 200%; long note; picker failure; delete confirmation; local save error; expanded photo pane.
# SCREEN-010 - Close batch

Linked flows: FLOW-008  
Linked requirements: REQ-008

## Purpose and hierarchy

Record an explicit terminal outcome-harvested, failed, or abandoned-with date and optional outcome-specific details before freeing capacity.

## States

- Harvested: optional actual mass and note.
- Failed: optional reason and note.
- Abandoned: optional reason and note.
- Validation: invalid date or mass remains inline.
- Local save failure retains all fields; offline is fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Save outcome is primary; Cancel leaves the batch active. Outcome uses radio buttons or a connected group, never icon-only selection. Standard harvest, failed, abandoned, date, mass, and save icons supplement labels.

## Text layout expectations

Outcome consequences are plain complete sentences. Mass uses an explicit metric unit and accepts no implied forecast. At 200% choices and actions stack without clipping.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact may use a full-height form instead of a cramped dialog; expanded may use a basic modal with bounded width. Focus starts at the heading/outcome, validation is announced, and cancellation has predictable back behavior.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard harvest, failed, abandoned, date, mass, save, and close icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Each outcome light/dark; harvested with mass; RU 200%; invalid mass/date; long reason; save failure; compact full-screen and expanded modal.

The release default is collection enabled. The persisted user toggle disables or re-enables future collection according to the platform SDK contract. Local reset does not claim to delete reports already sent to Firebase.

## Offline and cache behavior

- Core database, catalog, photos, plan, history, backup, export, and Settings work offline.
- A valid privacy-region response may be cached only until its accepted expiry, clamped to 72 hours.
- Missing/stale privacy data disables ads for that launch; it does not delay app startup or core screens.
- Crash reports may remain queued by the native SDK contract, but upload never blocks the UI.
- There is no cloud sync, merge policy, login token, or remote product cache.

## Retention and erasure

Product data remains until the user deletes individual records, uses Delete all local data, clears app storage, or uninstalls. Delete all removes database rows, private photos, product/settings state, ad-consent payload, and scheduled reminders, then returns to first run. It explains that previously sent Crashlytics reports and externally saved backup/CSV files are not deleted.

/** Public router -> retained Store -> production manager -> actual file-backed SQLite. */
class ProductionLifecycleFlowTest {
    @Test
    fun abandonRepeatAndActualStorageReopenPreserveTerminalHistory() = runTest {
        val directory = Files.createTempDirectory("sproutpace-terminal-").toFile()
        val url = "jdbc:sqlite:${directory.resolve("history.db").absolutePath}"
        try {
            val (original, repeated, observation) = Fixture(url, directory, initialize = true).use { fixture ->
                fixture.seedActiveBatch()
                fixture.root.open(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, "original")
                fixture.root.open(ScreenId.OBSERVATION_EDITOR, "original")
                advanceUntilIdle()
                val editor = fixture.root.stack.value.active.instance
                assertEquals(ScreenId.OBSERVATION_EDITOR, editor.model.value.screen)
                assertEquals("original", editor.model.value.fields.single { it.id.value == "batchId" }.value)
                assertTrue(editor.model.value.fields.single { it.id.value == "id" }.value.isNotBlank())
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.EditField("text", "Original cycle note"))
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.Submit("save-observation"))
                advanceUntilIdle()
                assertEquals(emptyMap(), editor.model.value.validationErrors)
                assertEquals(null, editor.model.value.errorKey)
                val observation = fixture.database.snapshot().observations.single()
                assertEquals("Original cycle note", observation.text)
                assertEquals(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, fixture.root.stack.value.active.configuration.screen)

                fixture.root.open(ScreenId.CLOSE_BATCH, "original")
                advanceUntilIdle()
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.ChooseOption("outcome", "abandoned"))
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.EditField("reason", "Travel"))
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.Submit("save-outcome"))
                fixture.root.confirmation.value.child?.instance?.confirm()
                advanceUntilIdle()
                val original = fixture.database.snapshot().batches.single()
                assertEquals(BatchState.ABANDONED, original.state)
                assertEquals("Travel", (original.outcome as BatchOutcome.Abandoned).reason)
                assertEquals(Placement.None, original.placement)
                assertTrue(original.actions.none { it.status == ScheduledActionStatus.PENDING })
                assertTrue(original.events.isNotEmpty())
                assertEquals(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, fixture.root.stack.value.active.configuration.screen)
                assertEquals(BatchState.ABANDONED, fixture.batchState())

                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.Submit("repeat-batch", original.id.value))
                advanceUntilIdle()
                assertEquals(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, fixture.root.stack.value.active.configuration.screen)
                val cancelledId = fixture.field("id")
                assertNotEquals(original.id.value, cancelledId)
                assertEquals(original.substrateSnapshot, fixture.field("substrate"))
                assertEquals("", fixture.field("anchorState"))
                assertEquals(listOf(original), fixture.database.snapshot().batches)
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.EditField("substrate", "Discard this draft"))
                fixture.root.back()
                assertNotNull(fixture.root.confirmation.value.child).instance.confirm()
                advanceUntilIdle()
                assertEquals(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, fixture.root.stack.value.active.configuration.screen)
                assertEquals(listOf(original), fixture.database.snapshot().batches)
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.Submit("repeat-batch", original.id.value))
                advanceUntilIdle()
                assertNotEquals(cancelledId, fixture.field("id"))
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.EditField("seedLot", "LOT-2"))
                fixture.dispatch(UiAction.Submit("save-batch"))
                advanceUntilIdle()
                val batches = fixture.database.snapshot().batches
                assertEquals(2, batches.size)
                assertEquals(original, batches.single { it.id == original.id })
                val repeated = batches.single { it.id != original.id }
                assertNotEquals(original.id, repeated.id)
                assertEquals(BatchState.PLANNED, repeated.state)
                assertEquals(original.recipe, repeated.recipe)
                assertEquals(original.tray, repeated.tray)
                assertEquals(original.substrateSnapshot, repeated.substrateSnapshot)
                assertEquals(original.actualSeedMass, repeated.actualSeedMass)
                assertEquals(original.supplier, repeated.supplier)
                assertEquals(original.cultivar, repeated.cultivar)
                assertEquals("LOT-2", repeated.seedLot)
                assertTrue(repeated.events.isEmpty())
                assertEquals(null, repeated.outcome)
                assertEquals(listOf(observation), fixture.database.snapshot().observations)
                Triple(original, repeated, observation)
            }

            Fixture(url, directory, initialize = false).use { reopened ->
                val snapshot = reopened.database.snapshot()
                assertEquals(original, snapshot.batches.single { it.id == original.id })
                assertEquals(repeated, snapshot.batches.single { it.id == repeated.id })
                assertEquals(listOf(observation), snapshot.observations)
                reopened.root.open(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, original.id.value)
                advanceUntilIdle()
                assertEquals(BatchState.ABANDONED, reopened.batchState())
                val model = reopened.root.stack.value.active.instance.model.value
                assertFalse(model.busy)
                assertTrue(model.items.any { it.id.startsWith("event:") })
                assertEquals("Original cycle note", model.items.single {
                    it.id == "observation:${observation.id.value}"
                }.authoredTitle)
                assertTrue(model.actions.any { it.id.value == "repeat-batch" })
            }
        } finally {
            directory.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private class Fixture(url: String, directory: java.io.File, initialize: Boolean) : AutoCloseable {
        private val driver = JdbcSqliteDriver(url).also { if (initialize) SproutPaceDatabase.Schema.create(it) }
        val database = LocalDatabase(object : SqlDriverFactory {
            override fun create(): SqlDriver = driver
            override fun close() = Unit
        }, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
        private val files = AndroidPrivateFileStore(directory.resolve("observation_photos"))
        private val manager = ProductionScreenDataManager(database, MultiplatformProductSettings(MapSettings()),
            workspaceRepository = LocalWorkspaceRepository(database, files, Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            now = { Instant.parse("2026-10-10T10:00:00Z") }, today = { LocalDate.parse("2026-10-10") })
        private val lifecycle = LifecycleRegistry().apply { resume() }
        val root = AppRootComponentDefault(DefaultComponentContext(lifecycle), ScreenComponentFactory(
            ScreenComponentDependencies(DefaultStoreFactory(), manager, Dispatchers.Unconfined),
        ), ScreenId.TRAYS)

        fun dispatch(action: UiAction) {
            val active = root.stack.value.active.instance
            RootActionRouter(root, active) { active.model.value.selectedItemId }.dispatch(action)
        }

        fun batchState(): BatchState = assertNotNull(root.stack.value.active.instance.model.value.items
            .first { it.batch != null && it.task == null }.batch).state

        fun field(id: String): String = root.stack.value.active.instance.model.value.fields.single { it.id.value == id }.value

        suspend fun seedActiveBatch() {
            execute(ScreenId.ZONES, "save-zone", "zone", mapOf("name" to "Shelf", "type" to "grow_light", "capacity" to "2"))
            execute(ScreenId.TRAY_SIZES, "save-tray-size", "tray", mapOf(
                "name" to "Tray", "shape" to "rectangle", "widthCm" to "25.4", "lengthCm" to "50.8",
            ))
            execute(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, "save-batch", "original", mapOf(
                "cultureId" to "radish", "trayId" to "tray", "substrate" to "Coco", "actualSeedMassGrams" to "12.5",
                "plannedSowDate" to "2026-10-10", "timeZoneId" to "UTC", "supplier" to "Seed shop",
                "cultivar" to "Ruby", "seedLot" to "LOT-1",
            ))
            execute(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, "confirm-sowing", "original", mapOf(
                "eventId" to "sown", "occurredAt" to "2026-10-10T09:00:00Z", "zoneId" to "zone",
            ))
        }

        private suspend fun execute(screen: ScreenId, operation: String, id: String, args: Map<String, String>) {
            manager.execute(screen, ScreenCommand(operation, id, args).newInvocation()).getOrThrow()
        }

        override fun close() {
            lifecycle.destroy()
            database.close()
            files.close()
        }
    }

class PlatformServicesTest {
    @Test
    fun ac074_photoPickerContractExposesOpaquePendingTokenWithoutPath() {
        val photo = ImportedFile(
            pendingToken = "picker-token.jpg",
            displayName = "seedlings.jpg",
            mediaType = "image/jpeg",
            sizeBytes = 42,
        )
        val backup = ImportedFile(
            appOwnedPath = "/private/imports/backup.zip",
            displayName = "backup.zip",
            mediaType = "application/zip",
            sizeBytes = 84,
        )

        assertEquals(null, photo.appOwnedPath)
        assertEquals("picker-token.jpg", photo.pendingToken)
        assertEquals(null, backup.pendingToken)
    }

    @Test
    fun permissionCheckRequestAndResumeAreSeparateTransitions() = runTest {
        val service = FakeNotificationPermissionService(
            initial = PermissionState.Denied(canRequestAgain = true),
            requestResult = PermissionState.Granted,
        )

        assertIs<PermissionState.Denied>(service.check())
        assertEquals(0, service.requestCount)
        assertEquals(PermissionState.Granted, service.request())
        service.setSystemState(PermissionState.Denied(canRequestAgain = false))
        assertIs<PermissionState.Denied>(service.onHostResume())
        assertEquals(2, service.checkCount)
        assertEquals(1, service.requestCount)
    }

    @Test
    fun dailySummaryRequiresWorkAndPastSoakIsNotRegistered() = runTest {
        val daily = reminder("daily", ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY, 2_000)
        val futureSoak = reminder("soak-future", ReminderKind.SOAK, 3_000)
        val pastSoak = reminder("soak-past", ReminderKind.SOAK, 900)
        val driver = FakeReminderDriver()

        val result = ReminderReconciler(driver).reconcile(
            plan = ReminderPlan(0, daily, listOf(futureSoak, pastSoak)),
            nowEpochMillis = 1_000,
            permission = PermissionState.Granted,
            reason = ReconciliationReason.PRODUCT_DATA_CHANGED,
        )

        assertEquals(setOf(futureSoak.id), result.scheduled)
        assertEquals(listOf(futureSoak.id), driver.scheduledCalls.map { it.id })
    }

    @Test
    fun restoreReconciliationCancelsObsoleteIdsWithoutDuplicates() = runTest {
        val obsolete = reminder("obsolete", ReminderKind.SOAK, 4_000)
        val daily = reminder("daily", ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY, 5_000)
        val driver = FakeReminderDriver(listOf(obsolete, daily))
        val reconciler = ReminderReconciler(driver)
        val plan = ReminderPlan(2, daily, emptyList())

        val first = reconciler.reconcile(plan, 1_000, PermissionState.Granted, ReconciliationReason.RESTORE_COMPLETED)
        val second = reconciler.reconcile(plan, 1_000, PermissionState.Granted, ReconciliationReason.PROCESS_RESTART)

        assertEquals(setOf(obsolete.id), first.cancelled)
        assertEquals(setOf(daily.id), first.scheduled)
        assertTrue(second.cancelled.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(2, driver.scheduledCalls.count { it.id == daily.id })
        assertEquals(1, driver.registeredIds().size)
    }

    @Test
    fun deniedPermissionCancelsPhysicalRegistrationsButNotLogicalPlan() = runTest {
        val daily = reminder("daily", ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY, 5_000)
        val driver = FakeReminderDriver(listOf(daily))

        val result = ReminderReconciler(driver).reconcile(
            ReminderPlan(1, daily, emptyList()),
            1_000,
            PermissionState.Denied(canRequestAgain = false),
            ReconciliationReason.PERMISSION_RESTORED,
        )

        assertEquals(setOf(daily.id), result.cancelled)
        assertTrue(result.scheduled.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun unknownPermissionDuringColdStartPreservesExistingRegistrationsUntilOsCheckCompletes() = runTest {
        val daily = reminder("daily", ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY, 5_000)
        val driver = FakeReminderDriver(listOf(daily))

        val result = ReminderReconciler(driver).reconcile(
            ReminderPlan(1, daily, emptyList()),
            1_000,
            PermissionState.Unknown,
            ReconciliationReason.APP_START,
        )

        assertTrue(result.cancelled.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(result.scheduled.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(daily.id), driver.registeredIds())
    }

    @Test
    fun restoreCompletionUsesCurrentPlanAndFutureOnlyReconciliation() = runTest {
        val daily = reminder("daily", ReminderKind.DAILY_SUMMARY, 5_000)
        val driver = FakeReminderDriver()
        val coordinator = ReminderLifecycleCoordinator(
            permissionService = FakeNotificationPermissionService(PermissionState.Granted),
            planSource = ReminderPlanSource { ReminderPlan(1, daily, emptyList()) },
            reconciler = ReminderReconciler(driver),
            clock = EpochMillisClock { 1_000 },
        )

        val result = coordinator.onRestoreCompleted()

        assertEquals(ReconciliationReason.RESTORE_COMPLETED, result.reason)
        assertEquals(setOf(daily.id), result.scheduled)
    }

    @Test
    fun physicalIdsAreStableAndDistinct() {
        val first = PhysicalReminderId("soak:batch-42")
        val same = PhysicalReminderId("soak:batch-42")
        val other = PhysicalReminderId("daily:summary")

        assertEquals(first.requestCode(), same.requestCode())
        assertNotEquals(first.requestCode(), other.requestCode())
    }

    @Test
    fun crashReportingUsesPersistedReleasePreferenceAndDisablesTestHosts() {
        val settings = FakeProductSettings(crashEnabled = true)
        val releaseDriver = FakeCrashReportingDriver()
        val release = CrashReportingCoordinator(settings, releaseDriver, RuntimeEnvironment.RELEASE)

        assertIs<CrashReportingState.Active>(release.applyStoredPreference())
        assertIs<CrashReportingState.Disabled>(release.updatePreference(false))
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), releaseDriver.collectionChanges)
        assertEquals(false, settings.crashReportingEnabled.value)

        val testDriver = FakeCrashReportingDriver()
        val test = CrashReportingCoordinator(settings, testDriver, RuntimeEnvironment.TEST)
        assertIs<CrashReportingState.Disabled>(test.updatePreference(true))
        assertEquals(listOf(false), testDriver.collectionChanges)
    }

    @Test
    fun unavailableCrashDriverNeverReceivesPrivateContext() {
        val settings = FakeProductSettings(crashEnabled = true)
        val driver = FakeCrashReportingDriver(isConfigured = false)
        val coordinator = CrashReportingCoordinator(settings, driver, RuntimeEnvironment.RELEASE)

        assertIs<CrashReportingState.Unavailable>(coordinator.applyStoredPreference())
        assertTrue(coordinator.recordReviewedTechnicalFailure(IllegalStateException()).isSuccess)
        assertTrue(driver.recordedFailureTypes.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun completeErasureClearsProductFilesAndEveryKnownPhysicalId() = runTest {
        val events = mutableListOf<String>()
        val driver = object : ReminderDriver {
            override suspend fun registeredIds() = emptySet<PhysicalReminderId>()
            override suspend fun schedule(reminder: PhysicalReminder) = Result.success(Unit)
            override suspend fun cancel(id: PhysicalReminderId) = runCatching { events += "cancel:${id.value}" }
        }
        val files = object : AppOwnedFileStore {
            override suspend fun delete(path: String) = Result.success(Unit)
            override suspend fun deleteAll() = runCatching { events += "files" }
        }
        val data = object : ProductDataEraser {
            override suspend fun eraseProductData() = runCatching { events += "data" }
        }

        val result = CompleteErasureCoordinator(data, files, driver).erase(
            setOf(PhysicalReminderId("soak:b"), PhysicalReminderId("daily:a")),
        )

        assertTrue(result.isSuccess)
        assertEquals(listOf("data", "files", "cancel:daily:a", "cancel:soak:b"), events)
    }

    private fun reminder(id: String, kind: ReminderKind, at: Long) = PhysicalReminder(
        id = PhysicalReminderId(id),
        kind = kind,
        fireAtEpochMillis = at,
        titleKey = if (kind == ReminderKind.SOAK) NativeTextKey.SOAK_COMPLETE_TITLE else NativeTextKey.DAILY_SUMMARY_TITLE,
        bodyKey = if (kind == ReminderKind.SOAK) NativeTextKey.SOAK_COMPLETE_BODY else NativeTextKey.DAILY_SUMMARY_BODY,
    )
}

private class FakeProductSettings(crashEnabled: Boolean) : ProductSettings {
    private val mutableTheme = MutableStateFlow(ThemePreference.SYSTEM)
    private val mutableCrash = MutableStateFlow(crashEnabled)
    private val mutableNotifications = MutableStateFlow(true)
    private val mutablePrivacy = MutableStateFlow<AdvertisingPrivacyState?>(null)

    override val theme: StateFlow<ThemePreference> = mutableTheme
    override val crashReportingEnabled: StateFlow<Boolean> = mutableCrash
    override val notificationsEnabled: StateFlow<Boolean> = mutableNotifications
    private val mutableSummaryTime = MutableStateFlow(SummaryLocalTime.DEFAULT)
    override val summaryTime: StateFlow<SummaryLocalTime> = mutableSummaryTime
    private val mutableSoakReminders = MutableStateFlow(true)
    override val soakRemindersEnabled: StateFlow<Boolean> = mutableSoakReminders
    override val privacyState: StateFlow<AdvertisingPrivacyState?> = mutablePrivacy

    override fun setTheme(value: ThemePreference) { mutableTheme.value = value }
    override fun setCrashReportingEnabled(value: Boolean) { mutableCrash.value = value }
    override fun setNotificationsEnabled(value: Boolean) { mutableNotifications.value = value }
    override fun setSummaryTime(value: SummaryLocalTime) { mutableSummaryTime.value = value }
    override fun setSoakRemindersEnabled(value: Boolean) { mutableSoakReminders.value = value }
    override fun setPrivacyState(value: AdvertisingPrivacyState?) { mutablePrivacy.value = value }
    override fun snapshot() = ProductPreferences(
        theme.value,
        crashReportingEnabled.value,
        notificationsEnabled.value,
        privacyState.value,
        summaryTime.value,
        soakRemindersEnabled.value,
    )
    override fun replace(value: ProductPreferences) {
        setTheme(value.theme)
        setCrashReportingEnabled(value.crashReportingEnabled)
        setNotificationsEnabled(value.notificationsEnabled)
        setPrivacyState(value.privacyState)
        setSummaryTime(value.summaryTime)
        setSoakRemindersEnabled(value.soakRemindersEnabled)
    }
    override fun clearProductState() {
        replace(ProductPreferences())
    }
}

    @Test
    fun failedSchedulingKeepsSavedPreferencesAndDoesNotHideTodayTasks() = runTest {
        val settings = FakeSettings(ProductPreferences(notificationsEnabled = true, soakRemindersEnabled = true))
        val source = ScreenSnapshot(items = listOf(com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.ScreenItem(
            "due-work", titleKey = com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.TextKey("today_next_action"),
        )))
        val scheduling = MutableStateFlow(ReminderSchedulingState.FAILED)
        val manager = ReminderAwareScreenDataManager(FixedManager(source), settings,
            FakeNotificationPermissionService(PermissionState.Granted), {}, scheduling)
        assertEquals("notifications_schedule_failed",
            manager.watch(ScreenId.NOTIFICATIONS).first().facts.single().valueKey?.value)
        assertEquals(source.copy(permissionState = com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.PermissionState.GRANTED),
            manager.watch(ScreenId.TODAY).first())
        assertTrue(settings.notificationsEnabled.value)
        assertTrue(settings.soakRemindersEnabled.value)
        scheduling.value = ReminderSchedulingState.IDLE
        assertTrue(manager.watch(ScreenId.NOTIFICATIONS).first().facts.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun previewPassesThroughProductionWrappersWithoutReminderReconciliation() = runTest {

        val expected = com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.StageChangeProjection(command, emptyList())
        var mutations = 0
        val delegate = object : ScreenDataManager {
            override fun watch(screen: ScreenId, stableId: String?) = flowOf(ScreenSnapshot())
            override suspend fun previewStage(command: ScreenCommand) = Result.success(expected)
            override suspend fun execute(screen: ScreenId, command: ScreenCommand): Result<ScreenSnapshot> {
                mutations += 1
                return Result.success(ScreenSnapshot())
            }
        }
        val reasons = mutableListOf<ReconciliationReason>()
        val wrapped = CrashAwareScreenDataManager(ReminderAwareScreenDataManager(delegate,
            FakeSettings(ProductPreferences()), FakeNotificationPermissionService(PermissionState.Granted), reasons::add),
            MutableStateFlow(com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.platform.CrashReportingState.Active(true)))
        assertEquals(expected, wrapped.previewStage(command).getOrThrow())
        assertEquals(0, mutations)
        assertTrue(reasons.isEmpty())
    }
