class FileBackedRestartTest {
    @Test fun interruptedRestoreRecoversCompletePreviousWorkspaceAfterDatabaseReopen() = runTest {
        listOf(false, true).forEach { databaseWasReplaced ->
            val root = Files.createTempDirectory("sproutpace-recovery-").toFile()
            val url = "jdbc:sqlite:${File(root, "workspace.db").absolutePath}"
            val factory = TestSqlDriverFactory(url = url)
            val database = LocalDatabase(factory, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
            val photos = AndroidPrivateFileStore(File(root, "photos"))
            val preferencesFile = File(root, "preferences.archive")
            val settings = FileProductSettings(preferencesFile)
            val fixture = restartFixture()
            database.saveZone(fixture.zone)
            database.saveTrayPreset(fixture.tray)
            database.saveRecipe(fixture.recipe)
            database.saveBatch(fixture.batch)
            database.saveObservation(fixture.observation)
            photos.write(requireNotNull(fixture.observation.photoId), fixture.photo)
            settings.replace(ProductPreferences(theme = ThemePreference.DARK))
            val service = LocalBackupService(database, photos, settings, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
            val previous = service.createArchive()

            // Persist exactly the production rollback record, then stop at either crash window.
            photos.writeRecoveryArchive(LocalBackupArchiveCodec().encode(previous))
            photos.replaceAll(emptyList())
            if (databaseWasReplaced) {
                database.erase()
                settings.clearProductState()
            }
            database.close()
            factory.close()
            photos.close()

            val reopenedFactory = TestSqlDriverFactory(url = url, initializeSchema = false)
            val reopened = LocalDatabase(reopenedFactory, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
            val reopenedPhotos = AndroidPrivateFileStore(File(root, "photos"))
            val reopenedSettings = FileProductSettings(preferencesFile)
            val failedRecovery = LocalBackupService(reopened, reopenedPhotos, reopenedSettings, Dispatchers.Unconfined,
                reminders = ReminderReconciliationPort { error("Physical reminders unavailable") })
            assertFailsWith<LocalDataException> { failedRecovery.recoverPendingReplacement() }
            assertNotNull(reopenedPhotos.readRecoveryArchive())
            val reminderSnapshots = mutableListOf<ProductSnapshot>()
            val recovery = LocalBackupService(reopened, reopenedPhotos, reopenedSettings, Dispatchers.Unconfined,
                reminders = ReminderReconciliationPort { reminderSnapshots += it })
            recovery.recoverPendingReplacement()
            assertEquals(previous, recovery.createArchive().copy(createdAt = previous.createdAt))
            assertEquals(listOf(previous.snapshot), reminderSnapshots)
            assertNull(reopenedPhotos.readRecoveryArchive())
            recovery.recoverPendingReplacement()
            assertEquals(1, reminderSnapshots.size)
            reopened.close()
            reopenedFactory.close()
            reopenedPhotos.close()
            root.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    @Test fun nativePhotoDirectoryRecoversInterruptedRenameBeforeJournalRecovery() = runTest {
        val root = Files.createTempDirectory("sproutpace-photo-swap-").toFile()
        val directory = File(root, "photos")
        val files = AndroidPrivateFileStore(directory)
        files.write(PhotoId("original"), byteArrayOf(1, 2))
        assertTrue(directory.renameTo(File(root, "photos.previous")))

    }

    @Test fun assignedHistoryAndPrivatePhotosSurviveActualCloseAndReopen() = runTest {
        val root = Files.createTempDirectory("sproutpace-reopen-").toFile()
        val databaseFile = File(root, "sproutpace.db")
        val photoRoot = File(root, "photos")
        val url = "jdbc:sqlite:${databaseFile.absolutePath}"
        val initialFactory = TestSqlDriverFactory(url = url)
        val initialDatabase = LocalDatabase(initialFactory, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
        val initialFiles = TestFilePrivateStore(photoRoot)
        val fixture = restartFixture()

        initialDatabase.saveZone(fixture.zone)
        initialDatabase.saveTrayPreset(fixture.tray)
        initialDatabase.saveRecipe(fixture.recipe)
        initialDatabase.saveBatch(fixture.batch)
        initialDatabase.savePlan(fixture.plan)
        val pending = InMemoryPendingPhotoImportStore().apply { stage("picked-reopen.jpg", fixture.photo) }
        val initialManager = ProductionScreenDataManager(
            database = initialDatabase,
            settings = MultiplatformProductSettings(MapSettings()),
            workspaceRepository = LocalWorkspaceRepository(initialDatabase, initialFiles, Dispatchers.Unconfined),
            pendingPhotos = pending,
        )
        initialManager.execute(
            ScreenId.OBSERVATION_EDITOR,
            ScreenCommand(
                operation = "save-observation",
                subjectId = fixture.observation.id.value,
                arguments = mapOf(
                    "batchId" to fixture.batch.id.value,
                    "occurredAt" to fixture.observation.occurredAt.toString(),
                    "text" to fixture.observation.text,
                    "photoId" to pendingPhotoDraftValue("picked-reopen.jpg"),
                ),
            ),
        ).getOrThrow()
        val savedObservation = initialDatabase.snapshot().observations.single()
        assertEquals(null, pending.read("picked-reopen.jpg"))
        initialDatabase.close()
        initialFiles.close()
        initialFactory.close()

        val reopenedFactory = TestSqlDriverFactory(url = url, initializeSchema = false)
        val reopenedDatabase = LocalDatabase(reopenedFactory, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
        val reopenedFiles = TestFilePrivateStore(photoRoot)

        val restored = reopenedDatabase.snapshot()
        assertEquals(listOf(fixture.zone), restored.zones)
        assertEquals(listOf(fixture.tray), restored.trayPresets)
        assertEquals(listOf(fixture.recipe), restored.recipes)
        assertEquals(listOf(fixture.batch), restored.batches)
        assertEquals(listOf(fixture.plan), restored.plans)
        assertEquals(listOf(savedObservation), restored.observations)
        assertContentEquals(fixture.photo, reopenedFiles.read(requireNotNull(savedObservation.photoId)))
        val reopenedManager = ProductionScreenDataManager(
            database = reopenedDatabase,
            settings = MultiplatformProductSettings(MapSettings()),
            workspaceRepository = LocalWorkspaceRepository(reopenedDatabase, reopenedFiles, Dispatchers.Unconfined),
        )
        val rendered = reopenedManager.watch(ScreenId.BATCH_DETAIL, fixture.batch.id.value).first()
            .items.single { it.id == "observation:${fixture.observation.id.value}" }
        assertEquals(savedObservation.photoId?.value, rendered.photo?.id)
        assertContentEquals(fixture.photo, rendered.photo?.bytes)

        reopenedDatabase.close()
        reopenedFiles.close()
        reopenedFactory.close()
        root.deleteRecursively()
    }

}

private class FileProductSettings(
    private val file: File,
    private val delegate: ProductSettings = MultiplatformProductSettings(MapSettings()),
) : ProductSettings by delegate {
    init {
        if (file.exists()) delegate.replace(LocalBackupArchiveCodec().decode(file.readBytes()).preferences)
    }
    override fun replace(value: ProductPreferences) {
        delegate.replace(value)
        val empty = ProductSnapshot(BackupManifest(1, 1, emptyMap(), emptyMap()),
            emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList(), emptyList())
        file.writeBytes(LocalBackupArchiveCodec().encode(LocalBackupArchive(empty, emptyList(), value)))
    }
    override fun clearProductState() = replace(ProductPreferences())
}

private class TestFilePrivateStore(private val root: File) : PrivateFileStore {
    private val journal = File(root.parentFile, "${root.name}.recovery")
    override suspend fun readRecoveryArchive(): ByteArray? = journal.takeIf(File::isFile)?.readBytes()
    override suspend fun writeRecoveryArchive(bytes: ByteArray?) {
        if (bytes == null) check(!journal.exists() || journal.delete()) else journal.writeBytes(bytes)
    }
    init { check(root.mkdirs() || root.isDirectory) }
    override suspend fun read(id: PhotoId): ByteArray? = file(id).takeIf(File::isFile)?.readBytes()
    override suspend fun write(id: PhotoId, bytes: ByteArray) { file(id).writeBytes(bytes) }
    override suspend fun delete(id: PhotoId) { check(!file(id).exists() || file(id).delete()) }
    override suspend fun exportAll(): List<PrivatePhoto> = root.listFiles().orEmpty().sortedBy(File::getName).map {
        val bytes = it.readBytes(); PrivatePhoto(PhotoId(it.name), bytes, Sha256.digest(bytes))
    }
    override suspend fun replaceAll(photos: List<PrivatePhoto>) {
        clear()
        photos.forEach { photo -> require(Sha256.digest(photo.bytes) == photo.sha256); write(photo.id, photo.bytes) }
    }
    override suspend fun clear() { root.listFiles().orEmpty().forEach { check(it.delete()) } }
    override fun close() = Unit
    private fun file(id: PhotoId) = File(root, id.value).also { require(it.parentFile == root) }
}

class LocalizedTextContractTest {
    @Test
    fun currentCatalogKeysResolveAlongsideHistoricalAliases() {
        SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.forEach { culture ->
            (listOf(culture.nameKey, culture.scientificNameKey, culture.substrateNoteKey, culture.lightingNoteKey) +
                culture.stages.map { it.instructionKey } + culture.safetyNoteKeys + culture.sources.map { it.titleKey })
                .forEach { strictTextResource(it.value) }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun everyTypedScreenContractKeyResolvesStrictly() {
        ScreenContractRegistry.contracts.values.forEach { contract ->
            strictTextResource("screen_${contract.id.name.lowercase()}_title")
            contract.fields.forEach { field ->
                strictTextResource(field.labelKey.value)
                field.options.forEach { option -> option.labelKey?.value?.let(::strictTextResource) }
            }
            contract.facts.forEach { fact ->
                strictTextResource(fact.labelKey.value)
                fact.valueKey?.value?.let(::strictTextResource)
            }
            contract.actions.forEach { action -> strictTextResource(action.labelKey.value) }
        }
        setOf(
            "choose_another_date", "choose_another_zone", "change_capacity", "leave_unassigned",
            "error_operation_failed", "preview_item_title", "preview_item_supporting",
            "plan_active", "plan_paused", "privacy_accepted", "privacy_declined", "privacy_undecided",
            "action_status_pending", "action_status_completed", "action_status_skipped", "action_status_cancelled",
            "safety_untreated_seed", "safety_clean_container", "safety_drinking_water", "safety_drainage",
            "safety_avoid_excess_moisture", "safety_allergy_awareness", "safety_images_not_diagnostic",
            "source_penn_state_growing_guide", "source_penn_state_abcs",
        ).forEach(::strictTextResource)
        val cultures = listOf("radish", "broccoli", "arugula", "mustard", "pea", "sunflower", "basil", "garden_cress")
        val suffixes = listOf(
            "name", "scientific_name", "soaking", "sowing", "blackout", "light_growth", "harvest",
            "substrate_note", "lighting_note",
        )
        cultures.forEach { culture -> suffixes.forEach { suffix -> strictTextResource("culture_${culture}_$suffix") } }
    }

    @Test
    fun unknownKeyFailsInsteadOfShowingRawKeyInProduction() {
        assertFailsWith<IllegalArgumentException> { strictTextResource("missing_production_key") }
    }
}

/** Owns recipe and batch editor mutations so the screen manager remains an orchestration boundary. */
internal class RecipeBatchCommandHandler(
    private val database: LocalDatabase,
    private val loadWorkspace: suspend () -> Workspace,
    private val now: () -> Instant,
    private val today: () -> LocalDate,
) {
    suspend fun saveRecipe(command: ScreenCommand) {
        require(SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.none { it.id.value == command.subject() }) { "Built-in guides are read-only" }
        val culture = SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.firstOrNull { it.id.value == command.required("cultureId") }
            ?: error("Unknown culture")
        val existing = loadWorkspace().recipes.firstOrNull { it.id.value == command.subject() }
        val stages = if (command.arguments.containsKey("stage1")) {
            command.recipeDraftStages(existing, culture)
        } else {
            existing?.stages ?: error("Recipe stage configuration is required")
        }
        validateRecipeStages(stages)
        database.saveRecipe(UserGrowRecipe(
            id = RecipeId(command.subject()),
            name = command.required("name"),
            cultureId = culture.id,
            stages = stages,
            density = existing?.takeIf { it.cultureId == culture.id }?.density ?: culture.seedDensity,
            substrate = command.required("substrate"),
            supplier = command.updatedOptional("supplier", existing?.supplier),
            cultivar = command.updatedOptional("cultivar", existing?.cultivar),
            seedLot = command.updatedOptional("seedLot", existing?.seedLot),
            germinationPercentage = if (command.arguments.containsKey("germinationPercentage")) {
                command.optionalPercentage("germinationPercentage")
            } else existing?.germinationPercentage,
        ))
    }

    suspend fun duplicateRecipe(command: ScreenCommand) {
        val workspace = loadWorkspace()
        val targetId = RecipeId(command.required("newId"))
        require(workspace.recipes.none { it.id == targetId })
        val source = workspace.recipes.firstOrNull { it.id.value == command.subject() }
        val duplicate = if (source != null) {
            source.copy(id = targetId, name = command.optional("name") ?: source.name)
        } else {
            val culture = SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.firstOrNull { it.id.value == command.subject() }
                ?: throw LocalDataException(LocalDataErrorKey.INVALID_COMMAND)
            UserGrowRecipe(
                id = targetId,
                name = command.required("name"),
                cultureId = culture.id,
                stages = culture.stages.map { RecipeStage(it.stage, it.duration, guidanceKey = it.instructionKey) },
                density = culture.seedDensity,

    suspend fun saveBatch(command: ScreenCommand) {
        val workspace = loadWorkspace()
        val recipeId = command.arguments["recipeId"]
        val recipeSnapshot = recipeSnapshot(workspace, recipeId, command.arguments["cultureId"])
        validateRecipeStages(recipeSnapshot.stages)
        val tray = traySnapshot(workspace, command.required("trayId"))
        val sourceRecipe = workspace.recipes.firstOrNull { it.id.value == recipeId }
        val recommended = MeasurementEngine.recommendedSeedMass(tray.shape, recipeSnapshot.density)
        val plannedSowDate = command.optional("plannedSowDate")?.let(LocalDate::parse) ?: today()
        val timeZoneId = command.optional("timeZoneId") ?: DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE
        val batchId = BatchId(command.subject())
        database.saveBatch(GrowBatch(
            id = batchId,
            recipe = recipeSnapshot,
            tray = tray,
            substrateSnapshot = command.optional("substrate") ?: sourceRecipe?.substrate
                ?: command.required("substrate"),
            recommendedSeedMass = recommended,
            actualSeedMass = command.optional("actualSeedMassGrams")?.let(::positiveGrams) ?: recommended,
            state = BatchState.PLANNED,
            placement = if (command.optional("zoneId") != null) placement(command, workspace) else Placement.None,
            events = emptyList(),
            actions = BatchPlanningEngine.plannedActions(
                batchId, recipeSnapshot.stages, plannedSowDate, command.fixedStageDates(), timeZoneId,
            ),
            supplier = command.optional("supplier") ?: sourceRecipe?.supplier,
            cultivar = command.optional("cultivar") ?: sourceRecipe?.cultivar,
            seedLot = command.optional("seedLot") ?: sourceRecipe?.seedLot,
            germinationPercentage = command.optionalPercentage("germinationPercentage")
                ?: sourceRecipe?.germinationPercentage,
            plannedSowDate = plannedSowDate,
            cultureIdSnapshot = command.optional("cultureId")?.let(::CultureId)
                ?: sourceRecipe?.cultureId ?: recipeSnapshot.builtInCultureId,
        ))
    }

    suspend fun correctBatch(command: ScreenCommand) {
        val workspace = loadWorkspace()
        val original = workspace.batch(command.subject())
        val tray = selectedTray(command, workspace)
        val plannedSowDate = command.optional("plannedSowDate")?.let(LocalDate::parse) ?: original.plannedSowDate
        val timeZoneId = command.optional("timeZoneId") ?: original.timeZoneId() ?: DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE
        val fixedDates = correctedFixedDates(command, original)
        val fields = correctedFields(command, original, workspace, tray, plannedSowDate)
        val events = BatchPlanningEngine.correctActualEventDates(fields, command.correctedActualDates())
        val scheduleChanged = plannedSowDate != original.plannedSowDate || fixedDates != original.fixedDates() ||
            timeZoneId != (original.timeZoneId() ?: DEFAULT_TIME_ZONE)
        val scheduled = if (scheduleChanged) events.withCorrectedSchedule(plannedSowDate, fixedDates, timeZoneId) else events
        val corrected = rebuildDependentFutureActions(command, scheduled, original)
        database.saveBatch(corrected)
    }

# FLOW-008 - Close, review, and repeat a batch

Linked requirements: REQ-008  
Linked screens: SCREEN-003, SCREEN-004, SCREEN-005, SCREEN-006, SCREEN-010

## Goal

Close a cycle with an explicit result, release resources, preserve history, and start a separate repeat when wanted.

## Entry and exit conditions

Enter from batch detail or a ready-for-harvest action. Exit in History or a prefilled new Batch editor.

## Ordered steps

1. Choose harvested, failed, or abandoned.
2. Record date, optional reason/note/assessment, and optional actual mass for harvest.
3. Save terminal outcome, free capacity, and cancel future reminders.
4. Review history or repeat into a new planned batch.

## Branches and resume

Cancellation keeps the batch active. Repeat preserves the original. Permanent deletion remains a separate FLOW-004 operation.

## AC-080

Given an active batch is ready or the user chooses early harvest
When harvested outcome is saved on SCREEN-010
Then the batch becomes terminal, its place is released on SCREEN-006, future reminders are cancelled, and it appears in SCREEN-003 History.

## AC-081

Given an active batch cannot continue
When failed outcome with optional reason is saved on SCREEN-010
Then it becomes terminal, frees capacity, cancels future reminders, and remains distinguishable as failed in SCREEN-003.

## AC-082

Given a planned or active batch exists
When abandoned outcome with optional reason is saved on SCREEN-010
Then it becomes terminal, frees any place, cancels future reminders, and remains distinguishable as abandoned in SCREEN-003.

## AC-083

Given a terminal batch is visible on SCREEN-003 or SCREEN-005
When the user chooses Repeat
Then SCREEN-004 opens a new planned batch with copied recipe/tray/substrate inputs and a new identity while the original remains unchanged.

## AC-084

Given one or more terminal batches exist
When the user opens SCREEN-003 History or a history item on SCREEN-005
Then outcome, dates, preserved snapshots, observations, and optional actual mass are readable after restart.

## AC-085

Given harvested outcome is being recorded on SCREEN-010
When the user enters a valid optional metric mass
Then that actual mass is stored and shown on SCREEN-005 without creating a predicted-yield field.
